title: Patchyard factory bench pairs
description: Structured source of truth for the (model x harness) Pairs table in docs/bench.md. Narrative sections of bench.md (seat orders, probes, rules) stay prose; evidence stays in research/. Edit this file, then run `python3 tools/check-bench.py --write`.

last_updated.description: Date the pairs data last changed; shown by bench.html

update_note.description: One-line summary of the latest pairs-data change

aa_index_version.description: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index version the aa_intelligence scores were read from; becomes the column header

preferred_harness.description: True only on rows using the current model-specific harness choice

detail.description: Score, timing, cost; inline markdown allowed; empty when untested

provenance.description: Jurisdiction/money-flow note for the A59/A61 rules; inline markdown allowed

standing.description: Current standing narrative; inline markdown, cite research/ records

visible_tps.description: Raw provider delivery after visible text begins; display string, empty when unmeasured

long_spec_wall.description: End-to-end long-spec wall time for this exact row; display string, empty when unmeasured

aa_intelligence.description: AA Intelligence Index score for the tracked model/effort variant; null when AA has no row

aa_cost_per_task_usd.description: Artificial Analysis provider-page Cost per Task USD for this model/provider pair; null when AA shows --, has no matching provider row, or the row names multiple providers

aa_coding_index.description: AA Coding Index for the tracked model/effort variant; null when AA has no matching-effort row

aa_agentic_index.description: AA Agentic Index for the tracked model/effort variant; null when AA has no matching-effort row

aa_snapshot_date.description: Date of the AA data snapshots the aa_* fields were last reconciled against (index snapshot + providers leaderboard)
